description:
Get pharmacogenomics relationships between genes and drug responses.
Data: Open Targets Platform 25.09 · table pharmacogenomics — one record = one PharmGKB variant or haplotype annotation linking a genotype to a drug response.
Key: studyId, targetFromSourceId, variantRsId, genotypeId, haplotypeId, phenotypeText (targetFromSourceId and variantRsId and genotypeId and haplotypeId and phenotypeText may be null).
Arguments: target_id accepts ensembl gene or hgnc symbol (resolved; unknown -> error); drug_id accepts chembl molecule or drug name (resolved; unknown -> error).
Results: ranked by evidenceLevel asc (verified by the harness); `_vbt.total` counts all matches; `_vbt.grains.drug` counts drugs; `_vbt.grains.variant` counts variants.
Empty vs not found: unknown identifiers are errors; an empty result is citable only as an absence. PharmGKB clinical annotations integrated by OT 25.09; absence means none curated.
evidenceLevel is the PharmGKB level: 1A (strongest) < 1B < 2A < 2B < 3 < 4 (weakest)

schema.description: Pass at least one of: target_id, drug_id.

drug_id.description: Accepts chembl_molecule, drug_name; resolved to one chembl_molecule (unknown values are errors, never empty results).

target_id.description: Accepts ensembl_gene, hgnc_symbol; resolved to one ensembl_gene (unknown values are errors, never empty results).
